Last Thursday, David and Grace went to the shopping mall. David learned a lot about math. David borrowed a book about math from the park. What's more, these jeans go with everything.
David plays football with Grace every Thursday. They took many photos at the cashier. Life is full of small surprises. What's more, she is writing her doctoral thesis on bees.
David drinks coffee after doing sports. Both of them like fish and coffee. There are always many people at the cashier. She plays the piano every evening.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the shopping mall by bike. The weather was sunny that day. David thinks math is interesting but a little difficult.
